title: Low-Sodium Smoky Vietnamese Thai-eggplant-makhua Claypot Sizzling Crepes
description: A winey, cheese-pull, cozy Vietnamese dish featuring Thai-eggplant-makhua, smoke-hot, low-sodium-friendly, form=banh-xeo, vessel=claypot.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together rice flour, water, and a pinch of salt to form a smooth batter.
Heat a claypot over medium-high heat and add a small amount of oil to the bottom.
Pour in the batter and tilt the claypot to evenly coat the bottom.
Add the coconut milk, Thai eggplant makhua, smoked tofu, fish sauce, and palm sugar to the claypot.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the eggplant starts to soften.
Add the garlic and galangal to the claypot and cook for another minute.
Reduce heat to medium-low and cook for 5-7 minutes or until the crepe is cooked through.
Use a spatula to loosen the crepe from the claypot and fold it in half to form a half-moon shape.
Repeat the process to make the remaining crepes.
